checked_releases.addon_description: Provenance is a local plagiarism and citation checker for Zotero. Pick a paper or draft file and it compares the text with the PDFs in your library. It finds copied and lightly reworded passages and says whether each one has a citation. It can also fetch a paper's reference list into a collection so you can check against what it cites. Checking runs fully on your computer. Reports are a single file you can filter, save as PDF or export as CSV.
